# Neighls Bohr

Neighls Bohr is the freckled Crystal Empire earth-pony stallion who earnestly asks Spike for an autograph in *Friendship is Magic*. Look for his golden-tan coat, pale mint-green mane, gray-green eyes, and **atom cutie mark**. He is a minor but speaking G4 television character, not a separate superhero or scientist established by the story.

[![Neighls Bohr — Hasbro Studios *Friendship is Magic* screen capture](https://vignette.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/0/08/Neighls_Bohr_ID_S4E24.png)](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/786333/fnfe-chapter-notes)

*Image credit: Hasbro Studios, television production; the linked Fimfiction post reproduces and discusses this show still.*

**Names and voice.** “Neighls Bohr” is a **fandom name**, a pun on physicist Niels Bohr prompted by his atomic cutie mark; its original coiner is not verified. “Atomic Crystal,” “Atomic Crystallite,” and “Beta Particle” are additional fan-tag names ([tag history](https://twibooru.org/tags/atomic%2Bcrystal)); both Atomic Crystal and Neighls Bohr were already used in [2015 fan writing](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/253309/2/pimp-spikes-swag-vol5-the-comeback/ch1-mina-wa-atarash-senpaku-tame-no-jikan-everyone-time-for-a-new-ship). Gameloft’s licensed mobile game instead names him **Crystal Empire Spectator**. The fan-maintained [Crystal Pony index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies) attributes his speaking voice to **Ashleigh Ball**; this is not a separately credited on-screen character name.

**Appearances.** His identified speaking appearance is *Equestria Games* (S4E24). Other identified background appearances include *The Crystalling* Parts 1–2 (S6E1–2), *The Times They Are A Changeling* (S6E16), *Fame and Misfortune* (S7E14), *Uncommon Bond* (S7E24), and *The Beginning of the End – Part 1* (S9E1). He is also noted in *Baby Flurry Heart’s Heartfelt Scrapbook* episode 9 and the season-four poster.

## Important moments

- **Spike still has an admirer — *Equestria Games* (S4E24).** After Spike learns Twilight secretly helped him light the torch and loses confidence, Neighls respectfully asks for his autograph; it is his clearest individual line. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w5tPOH4MBu4) — scene timestamp unavailable.
- **The Crystal Heart is restored — *The Crystalling – Part 2* (S6E2).** He is among the Crystal Empire spectators as Flurry Heart’s ceremony helps save their home from the blizzard; this is a significant *community* moment, not an individual speech or deed by him. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SCbeNMoY7xc) — scene timestamp unavailable.
